evidence: The film thickness was measured by cross-sectional scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and x-ray reflectometry (XRR) using a JEOL JSM-6335F SEM and a Philips MRD X’Pert system, respectively. Grazing incident angle x-ray diffraction (GIXD) using a Philips MRD X’Pert system operating with Cu Kα radiation (40 kV and 40 mA) was used to characterize the film microstructure. Atomic force microscopy (AFM) (Digital Instruments Dimension 3100) was used to examine the film surface morphology. To investigate chemical bonding states, x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) measurements were performed with a PerkinElmer PH1 ESCA system.
